decisive_items: Mature adipocytes extending into skeletal tissue
Subcutaneous-based proliferation of spindle cells with varying density
response.rationale: Fibrolipomatous hamartoma best fits the chronic, progressive subcutaneous spindle-cell proliferation with mature adipocytes infiltrating skeletal muscle and thickened collagen fragments, without pleomorphism. Nodular fasciitis is less likely due to the 10-year course and absence of myxoid stroma.

rejected.why: Typically acute, myxoid stroma, not 10-year progressive course
Madelung disease is symmetric cervical lipomatosis, lacks spindle-cell proliferation
No neural differentiation or specific nerve tissue features
Scleroderma lacks adipocytic infiltration and spindle-cell proliferation
Initial biopsy interpretation was superseded by surgical pathology findings
